risk_on.description: Allow higher turnover and offensive exposure.
risk_on.newCandidatePolicy: High-confidence newcomer can enter executable pool same day with <=10% trial position.

neutral.newCandidatePolicy: New candidate requires one-cycle confirmation before full sizing.

risk_off.description: Shrink risk quickly and preserve capital.
risk_off.newCandidatePolicy: No same-day newcomer buy unless explicit user confirmation.

momentumGate.rule: Do not chase candidates failing short-term momentum threshold; if unclear, HOLD.

drawdownGate.rule: If portfolio drawdown exceeds strategy threshold, force de-risk and cap new buys.
drawdownGate.note: 2026-03-17 review: -2.20% may be too conservative for aggressive_short_term mode. Current drawdown -4.11% blocks all aggressive entries. Consider relaxing to -5.00% or adding tiered response (e.g., -3% reduce size, -5% hard stop). Decision requires user confirmation.

poolMechanism.universeScope: All purchasable funds on TiantianFund or Alipay (not limited to existing holdings)
promotionRules: watchlist top-ranked candidate with verified code-name

oversoldRotationChannel.scope: All categories in TiantianFund/Alipay purchasable universe
oversoldRotationChannel.entryRule: Allow small trial buy (5-10%) when oversold rebound evidence is high-confidence and gates pass
oversoldRotationChannel.switchRule: Fund source can be domestic, overseas QDII, commodity, bond, or broad index as long as purchasable and verified
oversoldRotationChannel.exitRule: If rebound confirmation fails next cycle, de-risk to HOLD or defensive bucket
oversoldRotationChannel.note: Not limited to Nikkei/US/Gold; full-fund-universe rotation is required
